ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed distribution favoring low-intensity pixels (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) outliers concentrated at the margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity contiguous region across the entire central fluke body; localized high-intensity circular clusters (blobs) at distal tips and along the trailing edge topography.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped notch with a sharp interior angle and a vertical depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern across both lobes; variations include sharp peaks (5-15 pixels) and shallow valleys, with higher frequency near the medial notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: General convex sweep from the proximal water line to the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward vertical extensions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular white pixel aggregates (barnacle rosettes) visible on the left-most and right-most distal margins and trailing edge peaks.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy crustacean (barnacle) attachment on distal edges; visible white calcified mass clusters varying in diameter.
